core_obligations: Cover the fibre pointwise: for each point x of the fibre apply the pointwise statement to get an elementary etale neighbourhood of the base and an open subset of the base change containing x on which the pullback of the module is flat, and note that its fibre is an open neighbourhood of x in the fibre (proof lines 2814-2825).

Pass to finitely many points and dominate: since the fibre is quasi-compact, finitely many of those neighbourhoods cover it, and one chooses a single elementary etale neighbourhood of the base dominating all of them (proof lines 2826-2832).

Assemble the open set: take the union of the inverse images of the pointwise opens under the induced morphisms, which by construction contains the fibre, and observe that the pullback of the module to that union is flat over the local ring of the new base (proof lines 2833-2841).
proof_roadmap: Cover the fibre by the pointwise flat opens (proof lines 2814-2825).
Choose one dominating elementary etale neighbourhood (proof lines 2826-2832).
Take the union of the base changed opens and read off flatness (proof lines 2833-2841).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the finite type variant of the flat along the fibre statement: after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the point of the base there is an open subset of the base change containing the fibre on which the pullback of the finite type module is flat (statement lines 2794-2812, tag 05KV). The proof applies the pointwise statement at the points of the quasi-compact fibre, passes to finitely many points, chooses one dominating elementary etale neighbourhood, and then takes the union of the inverse images of the pointwise opens, which contains the fibre and on which the pullback is flat. The assembling of the open set is the substance, so the claim is H2.
